subject: Governance coverage tradeoffs — proposed vendor transition runway
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Catherine Liu <catherine@vanta.com>, Drata Sales <sales@drata.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governance coverage tradeoffs — proposed vendor transition runway

Hi Catherine / Drata team,

Thanks again for the demos this week. Monica and I pulled together an initial comparison and a proposed runway for a phased transition if we decide to consolidate off our current tooling. Attached is a short vendor_comparison_matrix.csv and a proposed-runway-schedule.pdf that sketches a 3-month parallel run, then a staged cutover per control domain.

High level asks from our side:
- Can Vanta confirm data export formats and retention for evidence we will need during a parallel-run (especially SCIM / audit log exports)?
- Drata: can you provide a redlineable SOW with a 60-day proof-of-concept clause and a short list of engineers for the POC?

Monica — can you and Marissa confirm which control families we need to prioritize for the POC (I suggest Identity/Access, Change Management, and Logging) and the internal owners to loop in?

Catherine: if you can share the export sample (CSV + event stream) that would help our infra team validate ingestion.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Head of Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_comparison_matrix.csv (spreadsheet), proposed-runway-schedule.pdf (PDF)
From: Catherine Liu <catherine@vanta.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance coverage tradeoffs — proposed vendor transition runway

Alex / Monica —

Appreciate the clear ask and the matrix. We can provide both CSV exports (evidence and control statuses) and an event stream dump for the trial period. For the POC we typically provide:
- scoped ingestion for up to 6 control families
- a named engineer for up to 40 hours of integration help
- export templates for logs and SCIM snapshots

I've attached a draft SOW (vanta-draft-sow.docx) that includes a 45-day POC option and a mutually agreed rollback plan. Key tradeoffs to call out:
- Coverage breadth vs. depth: we can fast-track Identity and Logging with near-complete automation, but Change Management controls will require some manual attestations during POC.
- Evidence ownership: during parallel runs we recommend retaining originals in your S3 bucket (you control retention) and pushing derived artifacts to our platform — this avoids lock-in during evaluation.

We can set up a short sync with your infra and secops teams on Wed morning to walk the export format.

Best,
Catherine Liu
Customer Success Manager
Vanta

Attachment: vanta-draft-sow.docx (Word)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Catherine Liu <catherine@vanta.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance coverage tradeoffs — proposed vendor transition runway

Thanks Catherine — that SOW and the export notes look good. Quick internal update for planning:
- Priority control families for POC: Identity/Access, Logging/Monitoring, and Change Management (as Alex suggested).
- Owners: Diane (IAM), Priya (Infra), and Tom (Platform SRE). I'll loop them into the Wed sync.
- Risk callouts: evidence format mismatch for our legacy SCM (we may need a small adapter). Budget for the POC is pre-approved up to $15k for third-party integration work.

Marissa — can you drop the license_matrix.xlsx into the drive folder and flag any existing commercial commitments that would prevent an early termination?

Alex — if we can lock a Wed 10am sync with Catherine and a 30-day milestone plan in the SOW, I'd be comfortable moving forward with the 45-day POC and parallel run.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Catherine Liu <catherine@vanta.com>, Drata Sales <sales@drata.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance coverage tradeoffs — proposed vendor transition runway

Thanks everyone — quick recap and next steps:

1) Wed 30 Jun, 10:00am PT: sync confirmed (Catherine + Vanta eng, Monica, Diane, Priya, Tom, Dylan attending). Calendar invite sent.
2) Catherine: please share the export sample and the final SOW redline by EOD Thu so Dylan can start a compatibility pass.
3) Marissa: upload license_matrix.xlsx and tag any blockers.
4) I'll draft a short internal comms note for the exec sponsors outlining the parallel-run approach and rollback criteria (will share for review).

If Drata has a comparable sample SOW we can review side-by-side in the sync — Catherine / Drata team, can you be prepared to discuss quick-win automations vs manual attestations?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
